title: Even if / even though: imagined or established?
explanation: even if引入尚未确定或作为假设提出的情况，后面的决定在该情况下仍成立。even though把情况作为已知事实来让步。We will meet even if it rains不能证明真的会下雨；We met even though it was raining把雨当成实际背景。区别在信息地位，而不仅在中文都能译成“即使”。
usage: 说明一项决定不依赖某个不确定情况，或强调结果与已知背景相反。
nuance: 未来条件从句通常用现在时，不把will机械地放进if从句；even though可根据实际时间使用过去或现在时。
structure: even if + present clause, will / modal + verb (future possibility)
even though + factual clause, contrasting main clause
formation: even if + present clause, will / modal + verb (future possibility)
even though + factual clause, contrasting main clause

examples.target: We will meet outside even if only two people come.
examples.zh: 即使只有两个人来，我们也会在外面碰面。

examples.target: We met outside even though only two people came.
examples.zh: 尽管只有两个人来了，我们还是在外面碰面了。

examples.target: I will keep a paper copy even if the online plan works well.
examples.zh: 即使线上计划运行良好，我也会保留一份纸质副本。

examples.target: She asked for more time even though she had prepared carefully.
examples.zh: 尽管她认真准备过了，她还是请求多一些时间。

notes: 等级用于学习编排，不代表官方穷尽语法清单。

commonMistakes.wrong: We will meet even if it will rain.
commonMistakes.correct: We will meet even if it rains.
commonMistakes.explanation: 表示未来条件时通常用现在时rains。主句的will不意味着条件从句也必须用will。

comparison.explanation: 普通if常把结果与条件相连；even if强调即使出现这个条件，主句的决定仍不变。

exercises.prompt: “We will meet even if only two people come.” 能确认什么？
acceptedAnswers: 两个人来这一可能性不会改变碰面的决定
exercises.explanation: even if不确认人数，强调决定在假设成立时仍不变。
options: 两个人来这一可能性不会改变碰面的决定
如果三个人来就一定取消

exercises.prompt: 你已确认昨天下雨，但仍按计划见面：We met outside ( ) it was raining.
exercises.explanation: 雨是实际发生的背景，用even though。

exercises.prompt: 今晚的天气还不确定，你决定无论下不下雨都见面。选择准确表达。
acceptedAnswers: We will meet even if it rains.
exercises.explanation: 把雨作为未确定的条件，同时保持决定不变。
options: We met even though it rained.
We will only meet if it rains.
We will meet even if it rains.

exercises.prompt: 改正未来条件句：We will meet even if it will rain.
acceptedAnswers: We will meet even if it rains.
exercises.explanation: 使用现在时表达未来条件；主句保留will。

exercises.prompt: 译成英语：尽管她认真准备过了，她还是请求多一些时间。
acceptedAnswers: She asked for more time even though she had prepared carefully.
exercises.explanation: even though引入已成立的准备背景；had prepared表示准备发生在请求之前。
